sources.title: kotak.biz payment collection app
sources.supports: Explicitly describes kotak.biz as an app for professionals and business owners to accept BHIM UPI, card and payment-link collections.

items.text: Kotak describes kotak.biz as a payment collection app for professionals and business owners, with BHIM UPI, card and payment-link collections.
slice’s digital-service terms require users to be at least 18, with a separate exception for specific services used by younger customers with a guardian’s consent.
slice’s terms permit customers over 10 and under 18 to use specific bank services with a lawful guardian’s consent and approval.
slice’s UPI terms require users to be residents of India.

sources.title: SmartHub Vyapar merchant app
sources.supports: Describes SmartHub Vyapar as an app for merchants, including UPI payment acceptance, business reports and staff access.

items.text: HDFC’s SmartHub Vyapar app helps merchants accept UPI and card payments, track collections and manage their businesses.

sources.title: ICICI Bank launches InstaBIZ for MSMEs and self-employed customers
sources.supports: The 2019 launch explicitly identifies MSMEs and self-employed customers as the audience for the InstaBIZ mobile app and web platform.

sources.title: ICICI Bank launches Mine for millennial customers
sources.supports: The 2020 launch identifies ages 18–35 for Mine and explicitly describes a customised iMobile app experience for this audience; it is historical audience evidence.

items.text: ICICI introduced InstaBIZ in 2019 for self-employed customers to handle business banking through its app or website.
ICICI’s 2019 InstaBIZ launch names micro, small and medium enterprises as an intended audience for its business banking app and website.
ICICI’s 2020 Mine launch targeted ages 18–35 and included a customised iMobile experience for that group.
IDFC FIRST’s UPI page explicitly offers merchants payment collection and payout services.
SBI’s UPI FAQ describes merchant registration and a Business tab in BHIM SBI Pay for payment confirmations, reports and agent management.

sources.title: Annual Report 2023–24, IPPB at a Glance, printed page 8
sources.supports: Explicitly discusses rural and urban customers alongside mobile app and WhatsApp banking; also describes Digital Dukandar merchant QR services available through mobile banking. These are product audiences, not app-user shares.

sources.title: Savings accounts — DigiSmart Savings Account
sources.supports: States that DigiSmart accounts are opened through the IPPB Mobile Banking App and are designed for individuals aged 18 and above with Aadhaar and PAN.

items.text: IPPB’s 2023–24 report names rural and urban customers when describing its mobile app and WhatsApp banking.
IPPB’s 2023–24 report describes Digital Dukandar merchant QR services and says these services are available through mobile banking.
IPPB lists age 18 and above for opening a DigiSmart Savings Account through its mobile banking app.

sources.title: Rural WMSEs as last mile distribution channel
sources.supports: The 7 August 2025 program report explicitly counts 10,000 women banking correspondents onboarded to Airtel Payments Bank’s Mitra app through She Leads Bharat: Udyam, a rural women-owned enterprise initiative. It does not describe Airtel Thanks consumer demographics.

items.text: 10,000 women banking correspondents onboarded through She Leads Bharat: Udyam.
items.population: Women banking correspondents onboarded to Airtel Payments Bank’s Mitra app through She Leads Bharat: Udyam

items.text: She Leads Bharat: Udyam targets rural women-owned small businesses and uses Mitra to onboard participants as Airtel banking correspondents.
Mitra is used by the program’s women-owned small businesses acting as Airtel banking correspondents.
FedMobile’s minor-account section permits minors over 10 with solely operated savings accounts, a unique mobile number and lower transaction limits.
Deutsche Bank’s UPI page allows NRI customers with Indian NRE or NRO accounts and a registered domestic or supported international mobile number.
J&K Bank’s mobile-banking terms exclude accounts held by minors and joint accounts that include a minor.

excludedItems.text: Canara ai1Pe’s FAQ directs non-individual businesses to merchant QR onboarding for receiving UPI payments; these accounts cannot transact through app mode.
excludedItems.reason: The cited merchant-QR route excludes these accounts from app-mode transactions.

items.text: Standard Chartered’s corporate UPI service includes a mobile app for collection requests, receiving payments and transaction notifications.

sources.title: Fino Mitra — developer app listing
sources.publisher: Fino Payments Bank on Google Play
sources.supports: The bank’s developer description explicitly identifies merchants as Fino Mitra’s users for banking and payment services; this is a separate app from FinoPay.

sources.title: Privacy Policy for FinoMitra App — Terms of Use
sources.supports: Defines the app’s customer as a Fino business correspondent and explicitly requires a minimum age of 18 to download FinoMitra.

items.text: Fino describes Fino Mitra as an app for its merchants to provide banking and payment services.
Fino Mitra’s terms require business correspondents to be at least 18 to download the app.

sources.title: digibank terms — savings account eligibility, section 2.2
sources.supports: Defines the savings account as opened through digibank and requires customers to be over 18, Indian citizens, Indian residents and tax residents only of India. This is account-opening eligibility, not an app-wide age distribution.

items.text: DBS’s digibank terms require customers to be over 18 to open its savings account through the app.
The digibank savings-account terms require Indian citizenship, Indian residence and tax residence only in India.
DBS’s UPI FAQ lets NRI customers with supported international mobile numbers register for UPI through the digibank app.

sources.title: NSDL Payments Bank terms and conditions
sources.supports: Defines a bank-account customer as an Indian individual above 18 years old; this age rule applies to the bank account, not every Jiffy feature.

sources.title: Jiffy Zero Balance Account
sources.supports: Explicitly offers bank-account opening through the NSDL Jiffy App, with UPI transactions and other banking services.

items.text: For the bank account opened through Jiffy, NSDL’s terms define customers as Indian individuals above 18.
KVB’s DLite FAQ says only customers above 18 can access the app.
BHIM IOB UPI’s FAQ describes an “I am a Merchant” registration option inside the app.
